cohort: 52 women who underwent elective caesarean section at the Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS, Rome, Italy, between December 2021 and October 2022
finding: There was no significant difference in total cumulative dose of morphine consumed in the first 24 hours after elective caesarean section between women who received ESPB and those who received pQLB.
